findings.issue: כִּי is only a conjunction; «cuando» selects the temporal sense and closes if/that/because.
Qal imperfect 3ms is smoothed to the subjunctive vote; person and number stay 3ms.
The articular qal active participle masculine singular (the one going out) is «lo saliente», which can also be read as a salient or protrusion.

notes: Cognates vote/voto, jurar/juramento, and atar/atadura, Jehová, the niphal infinitive absolute as an infinitive, hiphil profanará, and the 3ms suffixes match the tokens.
